emergency-info.title: Set Up Your Phone's Emergency Info
emergency-info.why: If you're ever hurt and can't speak, a paramedic or passer-by can see who to call and anything they need to know, without unlocking your phone.

iPhone: Open Health, tap your photo, then Medical ID.
Tap Edit and add an emergency contact.
Android: Open Settings and find Safety & emergency.
Add your medical information and an emergency contact.
Menu names vary by phone maker, so search Settings for "emergency" if you can't see it.

emergency-info.feedback: Nice. That's the kind of thing nobody thinks about until it matters.

first-aid-app.title: Download A First Aid App
first-aid-app.why: If someone near you collapses, is badly cut or starts choking, step-by-step instructions on your phone can help you act instead of freeze. The Red Cross app works offline, so it's there even with no signal.
steps: Open your app store and search "Red Cross First Aid".
Pick the version from your country's Red Cross or Red Crescent. Most countries have their own, and it's free.
Open it once and skim one guide, so you know where things are.
first-aid-app.feedback: Next time someone near you needs help, the steps are in your pocket.
first-aid-app.receipt: First aid app on your phone
first-aid-app.outcome: you're ready to help someone else

thank-you.title: Send A Specific Thank-You To Someone
thank-you.why: People tend to underestimate how much a specific thank-you means to the person getting it.
steps: Think of one person who did something for you this year.
Message them: what they did, and what difference it made.
thank-you.helper: "Random, but I've been meaning to say thanks for ___. It honestly made ___ easier."
thank-you.feedback: Someone's going to read that and have a better day.

local-review.title: Leave A Real Review For A Small Local Business
local-review.why: For a small business, one specific review from a real customer can matter more than any ad.
steps: Think of a small local place you like.
Leave a review on whichever map or review app you use.
Mention one specific thing you liked.
local-review.outcome: a small business is easier to find
